description: Round 13 evidence for the rigid skater head pose (helmet + face as one piece). Cameras were refitted on the BODY only (head masked out of model and photo) so the head estimate does not feed back into the cameras; then the unturned round-12 helmet was rotated (yaw, pitch, roll about the neck point (6.5, -1.7, 37.0), mold units) and, per view, shifted freely in the image to best overlap the photographed blue helmet (the free shift absorbs the ~1-unit camera error at the head). Score: mean helmet IoU over 22 frames (work image 700 px).

chosen.notes: Yaw is well supported (front, elevated and right-side frames). Pitch: the helmet outline prefers ~10 deg front-down, but that hides the photographed face under the helmet front edge in the elevated front views; 5 deg chosen with a wider front opening. Roll: the grid is flat within 0.01. Positive roll (15-25 deg, from side-frame edge heights) made the face lean the wrong way in the near-frontal frames 13.25/14.50 s, whose own preference was -5 deg. Helmet-registered face centroids in the front views fell between 0 and 15 deg; 0 chosen. The left-side frames (8.50-9.25 s) individually prefer yaw -10 and pitch 25-30: unresolved, likely camera error.

rejected.joint_fit_without_per_view_shift: yaw 4-8 deg; its helmet mask near the head also contains the collar (IoU ~0.55), so it was not used
rejected.face_turned_under_straight_helmet: rounds 9-12 (face 28-38 deg, helmet 0 deg): the face hung off the helmet's front corner

face_in_head.method: helmet-registered face centroids (photo minus model) in 11 frames, least-squares single 3D offset
face_in_head.residual_note: after the offset, right-side frames (3.75-4.50 s) still see the face ~1.5 units lower and left-side frames (8.50-9.25 s) ~1.4 units higher than the model; the front views do not support the lateral shift that would explain both, so it is left as a camera/evidence contradiction
face_in_head.note_r13_final: after setting roll 0, a further +0.4 (toward the figure's left) from the front-view centroids; the remaining forward/back component was not applied (side profiles show the face already slightly behind the helmet front)
